sub_theme: What Plants Need to Grow and Stay Healthy

lessons.title: Non-Fiction: What Do Plants Need?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about plant needs from a non-fiction text.
success_criteria: I can find a fact about what plants need.
I can answer a question using the text.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a non-fiction text about what plants need to grow and stay healthy.
lessons.independent_task: Children read an extract and answer retrieval questions.
key_questions: Where did you find that fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences using text evidence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note non-fiction retrieval skill — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap facts found about plant needs.
lessons.home_link: Find a fact about plant needs at home.

lessons.title: Measuring Water for Plants: Capacity
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to measure capacity using standard units.
success_criteria: I can measure water using millilitres.
I can compare two amounts.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce measuring capacity using millilitres with a measuring jug, in the context of watering plants.
lessons.independent_task: Children measure and compare amounts of water using a measuring jug.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record introduction of standard capacity units, a new Year 2 skill — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Measure water using a measuring jug at home if available.

lessons.title: What Do Plants Need to Grow? (In Depth)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe in detail what plants need to grow and stay healthy.
success_criteria: I can name water, light and a suitable temperature as plant needs.
I can explain why each is important.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap basic plant needs from Year 1.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss in more depth why plants need water, light, and a suitable temperature to grow and stay healthy.
lessons.independent_task: Children record why each plant need is important, using more detailed reasoning than in Year 1.
key_questions: Why does a plant need light?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the science behind each need in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note deepened understanding of plant needs compared to Year 1 — evidence for SCI.PLA.
lessons.plenary: Recap plant needs and their importance.
lessons.home_link: Help water a plant at home and explain why it needs it.

lessons.title: Writing Plant Care Instructions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write detailed instructions for caring for a plant.
success_criteria: I can write instructions using sequencing words.
I can explain why each step matters.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing detailed plant care instructions, including reasons for each step.
lessons.independent_task: Children write plant care instructions with reasoning for a chosen plant.

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 5+ detailed steps with reasoning independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note instructional writing with explanatory reasoning, more advanced than Year 1 — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.plenary: Share plant care instructions with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Write care instructions for a plant at home.

lessons.title: Fair Test Setup: Equal Groups of Plants
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply equal grouping to set up a fair test.
success_criteria: I can divide plants into equal groups.
I can explain why this is fair.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model dividing plants into equal groups for a fair test (e.g. some with light, some without).
lessons.independent_task: Children divide plant counters into equal groups for a fair test setup, explaining fairness.
key_questions: How many groups? How many in each?
Why must the groups be equal?

differentiation.support: Divide into 2 equal groups with support
differentiation.greater_depth: Divide into 3+ equal groups and explain fairness reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of division/equal grouping to scientific fair testing — evidence for MATHS.N3/SCI.PLA.
lessons.home_link: Practise dividing objects into equal groups at home.

lessons.title: Setting Up a Fair Test: Plants and Light
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to set up a fair test to investigate plants' need for light.
success_criteria: I can set up a fair test.
I can predict the outcome.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model setting up a fair test with two plants — one in light, one in a dark cupboard, keeping other variables the same.
lessons.independent_task: Children help set up the fair test, predicting what will happen to each plant.
key_questions: What are we keeping the same?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note fair testing skill, a key working scientifically objective — evidence for SCI.PLA.
lessons.plenary: Recap the fair test set up and predictions made.
lessons.home_link: Predict what would happen to a plant kept in the dark.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Plant Needs Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read plant-needs-themed words.
success_criteria: I can read plant needs words.
I can read a sentence about plant needs.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to plant-needs-themed words (e.g. 'water', 'light', 'warmth').
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading plant needs words over the week.

lessons.title: Plant Needs Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve addition/subtraction word problems using a plant needs context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies to 100.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a plant care context (e.g. millilitres of water used).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve plant-needs-themed word problems within 100, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a plant needs word problem for your family.

lessons.title: What If a Plant Gets Too Much Water?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe what happens if a plant's needs aren't balanced correctly.
success_criteria: I can say what happens with too much/too little water.
I can say why balance matters.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what happens to overwatered/underwatered plants.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss that plants need the right amount of water, light, and warmth — not too much or too little.
lessons.independent_task: Children record what happens if a plant's needs are unbalanced (too much/too little), using pictures/diagrams.
key_questions: What happens with too much water?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the science of balance in more detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note deeper understanding of plant needs requiring balance, not just presence — evidence for SCI.PLA.
lessons.plenary: Recap the importance of balanced plant care.
lessons.home_link: Check if a plant at home has the right amount of water.

lessons.title: Presenting Plant Care Advice
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to present plant care advice clearly to the class.
success_criteria: I can share plant care advice.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap plant care instructions from Tuesday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes clear, helpful advice.
lessons.independent_task: Children present their plant care advice to a small group, answering a question.
key_questions: Can you answer a question about it?

differentiation.greater_depth: Present unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and application of science knowledge — evidence for ENG.SL1/SCI.PLA.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all the plant care advice shared.
lessons.home_link: Give plant care advice to your family.

lessons.title: Recording Fair Test Observations
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to record observations from the fair test in a simple table.
success_criteria: I can complete an observation table.
I can compare the two plants.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the fair test set up on Tuesday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recording observations of the two test plants in a comparison table.
lessons.independent_task: Children observe and record the current state of both plants in the fair test, comparing them.
key_questions: What do you notice about each plant?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note data recording applied to an ongoing scientific investigation — evidence for MATHS.STAT/SCI.PLA.
lessons.plenary: Recap the observations recorded so far.
lessons.home_link: Observe a plant at home and record what you notice.

lessons.title: Comparing Our Fair Test Plants
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare the two plants in the fair test and draw a conclusion.
success_criteria: I can compare the two plants.
I can draw a conclusion about light.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model drawing a conclusion from the fair test comparison (the plant with light growing better).
lessons.independent_task: Children draw and record their conclusion about the plants' need for light based on the fair test.
key_questions: What does the test show about light?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the conclusion using scientific reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note conclusion-drawing skill, a key working scientifically objective — evidence for SCI.PLA.
lessons.home_link: Share the fair test conclusion with your family.

lessons.title: Plant Needs Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about plant needs.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's plant needs learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about plant needs, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What does a plant need to grow?
Why might a plant without light grow poorly?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on plant needs facts you learned.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Capacity, Equal Groups, Data
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply capacity, equal grouping and data skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can measure capacity.
I can divide into equal groups.
I can record data.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the week's capacity, grouping, and data learning.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 3 stations covering each skill.
key_questions: How many in each equal group?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 27 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.MEA/N3/STAT.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising measuring capacity over the weekend.

lessons.title: Plant Needs Topic Recap and Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key learning about what plants need to grow and stay healthy.
success_criteria: I can name what plants need.
I can explain the fair test conclusion.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap quiz format covering plant needs and the fair test.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a review worksheet and contribute to a class 'What Plants Need' display.
key_questions: What have we learned about plant needs?
What did our fair test show?

differentiation.support: Word bank and picture support provided

lessons.assessment_notes: Note in-depth plant needs and fair testing understanding, setting up ongoing plant recording next week — evidence for SCI.PLA.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the week's plant needs learning.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about plant needs with your family.
